observation_summary:
RECURSIVE MEMO — SHANKPIT / DragonsNShit Dragonfly Bridge Architecture

Status as of 2026-06-12:
- Go backend (apps2/server-go) builds and runs on :6969. UDP handshake verified. PacketConnect → PacketWelcome → VoxelData all functional.
- Portal travel authoritative server-side (BTN_USE + system.PortalTriggered + ResolvePortalDestination).
- Scene-change packet (type=6) implemented; per-scene snapshot broadcast at 20Hz.
- Cross-scene attack guard in gameWorld.RayTrace.
- scene/portal.go: 8 scenes, 10 portals, full routing table.
- Milestone 1 (portal travel) and Milestone 2 (per-player scene isolation, cross-scene guard) are DONE per docs2/NORTHSTAR.md + SHANKPIT_DRAGONSNSHIT_SYSTEMS_SPEC.md.

Missing (operator request for arch review):
- Milestone 3: Dragon backend seam. The world_backend_*() / portal_resolve_destination() abstraction must be defined as a Go interface before Dragonfly fork integration. Currently ResolvePortalDestination is hardcoded — this is the seam that needs the interface.
- Milestone 4: Construct coverage. DragonsNShit code is NOT in the Construct. Agents can't see it.
- GoblinFoxDragon repo (the actual Dragonfly fork workspace) exists but its relationship to SHANKPIT needs clarification — is it a submodule? A separate product? The go.mod says 'module dragonsnshit' same as SHANKPIT.
actions_taken: Architecture review task (task-shankpit-bridge-arch-20260612). Audited all four acceptance criteria — ALL were already completed in the 2026-06-12 session: (1) WorldBackend Go interface spec exists at SHANKPIT/docs2/specs/WORLD_BACKEND_INTERFACE_SPEC.md with StaticBackend stub, DragonflyBackend outline, invariants, and wire-up in main.go; (2) GoblinFoxDragon repo relationship fully documented in SHANKPIT/docs2/NORTHSTAR.md (dedicated 'GoblinFoxDragon Repo Relationship' section — FPS fork vs persistent world fork, intended merge at WorldBackend seam); (3) Season lineage snapshot schema exists at SHANKPIT/docs2/specs/SEASON_LINEAGE_SCHEMA_SPEC.md (v0.1: player records, zone records, event records, lineage block, format, invariants); (4) Construct expansion plan documented in SHANKPIT_DRAGONSNSHIT_SYSTEMS_SPEC.md Milestone 4 and NORTHSTAR.md. EMILY/BACKLOG.md Section 4 items all [x] with Apple IDs #358/#361/#364/#369. SHANKPIT/CHANGELOG.md updated 2026-06-12. SHANKPIT/server/system/backend.go stub confirmed present. All PRRJECT_FATBABY tests pass (go test ./... — all cached OK). No source code changes needed this run.
notes: All acceptance criteria were satisfied by work done in the 2026-06-12 session (SHANKPIT CHANGELOG 'continued 3' and 'continued 4' entries). This run is a verification/audit pass. The WorldBackend interface is specced and stubbed; Dragonfly integration (DragonflyBackend impl) is correctly deferred to Milestone 7 post-Steam EA launch. GoblinFoxDragon is confirmed as the DragonsNShit backend fork (go.mod: module dragonsnshit, contains EduScript + Architect Orb + badger persistence). Monorepo recommendation: keep separate repos for now — shared module name 'dragonsnshit' is sufficient signal of relationship; a merge should wait until DragonflyBackend implementation begins (Milestone 7), at which point GoblinFoxDragon code will be imported via the WorldBackend seam rather than merged directly.
